entries.1f45aac1794918bd: It manufactures and sells five regenerative medical products: autologous cultured epidermis JACE, autologous cultured cartilage JACK, autologous cultured corneal epithelium NEPIC, autologous cultured oral mucosal epithelium OCURAL and melanocyte-containing autologous cultured epidermis Jasmine. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥1,354 million from the Regenerative Medical Products Business, ¥546 million from the Regenerative Medicine Contract Business and ¥281 million from the LabCyte Business.

entries.2328297cf0830721: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,182 million, a decrease from the previous fiscal year. The Regenerative Medical Products Business declined due to the completion of orders for congenital giant pigmented nevus and epidermolysis bullosa, among other factors, and the Regenerative Medicine Contract Business declined due to a timing shift of a Teijin-related milestone to the following fiscal year and the absence of spot income from a specific customer recorded in the previous year. On the other hand, the LabCyte Business increased due to growing interest in Europe in the skin sensitization test method EpiSensA, among other factors. Autologous cultured cartilage JACK for knee osteoarthritis received insurance coverage in January 2026, and the approval application for allogeneic (same-species) cultured epidermis is a milestone for future expansion.
entries.27c3e336e9ccfed0: Net loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥734 million.

entries.2a74f50b083f418a: It has adopted 'Making regenerative medicine ordinary medicine' as its vision, and its management strategy is to expand existing businesses and develop into new products and fields. In the Regenerative Medical Products Business, it will establish autologous cultured epidermis JACE as the standard treatment for severe burns; for autologous cultured cartilage JACK, it will expand the number of facilities and cases, centered on extending its indication to knee osteoarthritis; and it will promote the early spread of melanocyte-containing autologous cultured epidermis Jasmine and the development and overseas expansion of dried allogeneic (same-species) cultured epidermis. It will build a sales structure for autologous cultured corneal epithelium NEPIC and autologous cultured oral mucosal epithelium OCURAL in collaboration with Nidek Co., Ltd., and in the cancer field it aims to launch an autologous CAR-T cell product it is developing with Nagoya University. In the Regenerative Medicine Contract Business, it supports customers in commercializing their seed technologies, and in the LabCyte Business it will advance overseas expansion.

entries.56a7051a663a378f: The company is one of the leading companies in Japan in terms of the number of approved regenerative medical products, and has products in three fields: skin, cartilage and cornea. It is in a position to promote the industrialization of regenerative medicine in collaboration with its parent company, Teijin Limited, and Teijin Regenet Co., Ltd., a member of the Teijin Group.
entries.56b94f6a173c9bb5: Autologous cultured oral mucosal epithelium OCURAL (treatment of limbal stem cell deficiency)
entries.64b83735b5996570: Of the 25 regenerative medical products approved in Japan, the company has obtained approval for five: autologous cultured epidermis JACE is the first in Japan, and autologous cultured cartilage JACK and autologous cultured corneal epithelium NEPIC are the first regenerative medical products in Japan in their respective fields. With the cell culture technology and manufacturing and quality control know-how it has developed since its establishment in 1999, and manufacturing facilities compliant with GCTP, it has a structure that can consistently support everything from in-house product development to contract services.

entries.6e3d0b477ea78525: This business manufactures and sells regenerative medical products, made by culturing patients' own cells, for medical institutions. It has five products: autologous cultured epidermis Jeisu, autologous cultured cartilage Jakku, autologous cultured corneal epithelium Nepikku, autologous cultured oral mucosal epithelium Okyuraru, and autologous cultured epidermis containing melanocytes Jasumin. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,354 million.
